names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Σιλβέστρος της Ομπνόρα», with the rank word left off.

The two words the day’s line and the life’s own title both use — «Прп. Сильвестра Обнорского» and «Преподобный Сильвестр Обнорский» — with the rank stripped per BRIEF.md §4. The name index at page 1994 is titled «Сильвестр Обнорский, Пошехонский, прп.» and carries A SECOND TOPONYM, «Пошехонский», which neither the line nor the life repeats: joining two toponyms into one stored form is a reading nobody here has done, so the form takes the two words that are everywhere on the source and the third is recorded here. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'обнорскии сильвестр' has no other holder, where the bare «σιλβεστροσ» fold holds five.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Σιλβέστρος κοιμήθηκε το έτος 1479 και ενταφιάσθηκε στην δεξιά πλευρά του ναού της Αναστάσεως», and the page heads him «(; - 1479)». It says he was born in the fifteenth century and gives no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 25 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Сильвестра Обнорского (1379).»

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. A YEAR CONFLICT INSIDE THE ONE SOURCE, AND `dates` WAS NOT TOUCHED: the day line heads him «(1379)», while the life the same line links, life932, ends «Преподобный скончался 25 апреля 1479 года и был погребен справа от деревянного Воскресенского храма». The folder already held 1479 off saint.gr, and the Russian life agrees with it against the Russian line, so nothing moved; a hundred years out on the line, with the source’s own life contradicting it, reads as a slip in the line, but a slip read is not a slip proved and it is reported. The life also confirms the day this row stands on. ITS CONTENT IS LARGELY THE SAME READING saint.gr already gave the folder — the discipleship under Sergius of Radonezh at the Trinity monastery, the cross set up in the thick forest on the Obnora, the peasant who lost his way and the pillar of cloud, the bark and roots and the angel’s touch, the blessing of the hierarch Alexis of Moscow for the church of the Resurrection, the forbidden grove and the four wells, and the dying counsel. WHAT IS NEW IN IT is the record of his wonders from the year 1645, twenty-three of them, twelve of possession and six of diseases of the eye, and the hieromonk «Иов» struck blind for having the forbidden grove cut for firewood and given his sight back after four weeks of repentance; that is the paragraph added to the life. The page heads «Дни памяти: 25 апреля , 23 мая (Ростов.)»; 23 мая is the synaxis of the saints of Rostov, NOT a second feast of this folder, and THAT DAY PAGE WAS NOT READ. The day page prints three hymns under his name, «Тропарь преподобного Сильвестра Обнорского» (глас 6), «Ин тропарь» (глас 4) and «Кондак» (глас 6), each of which names Сильвестр, and all three are on this folder now, which had no hymn of any kind. The name link, page 1994, is titled «Сильвестр Обнорский, Пошехонский, прп.» and adds the second toponym «Пошехонский», which neither the line nor the life uses. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Σιλβέστρος της Ομπνόρα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page makes him a fifteenth-century Russian who left the world for the monastery of the Holy Trinity, where he was a novice and a subordinate of Sergius of Radonezh — cross-referenced to 5 Ιουλίου — and was then blessed to go alone into the wilderness; sets his cross and his cell in the thick forest beside the river Obnora, which runs on into the Kostroma; tells of the peasant who lost his way and found the cell, of the bright rays and the layer of cloud people had seen above it, of the saint's bitter tears that his solitude was discovered, of the bark and roots he lived on and the angel in the form of a wonderful man who touched his hand when he fell down from weakness; of the brethren who gathered, of his journey to Moscow for the blessing of Alexis — cross-referenced to 12 Φεβρουαρίου — who gave him an antimension and made him abbot of the new monastery; of the «απαγορευμένο άλσος», the forbidden grove where he told them to fell no tree and dug three wells, and a fourth on a hillside by the Obnora; and of his last words to the brethren in his incurable illness. It says he died in 1479 and was buried on the right side of the church of the Resurrection, and under «Ιερά Λείψανα» puts his relics at the monastery of the Mother of God of Borok in the Kostroma country. It prints no hymn. The corpus's Silvester of Omsk, Sylvester of Rome and Sylvester of the Kyiv Caves are other men on other days.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

hymns.text: Иже измлада Христа возлюбив/ и верою к Нему приближся,/ изнурил еси, в пустыни живый, многострадальное тело твое./ Тем, блаженне Сильвестре, со Ангелы ликовствуя,/ моли Христа Бога мир мирови даровати/ и буди помощник верою призывающим тя на помощь/ и чтущим святую память твою.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Тропарь преподобного Сильвестра Обнорского», глас 6, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 25 апреля ст. ст.

english.text: Having loved Christ from thy youth and drawn near to Him in faith, thou didst wear out thy much-suffering body, living in the wilderness. Therefore, O blessed Silvester, rejoicing with the angels, pray to Christ God to grant peace to the world, and be a helper to those who call upon thee in faith for help and who honour thy holy memory.

hymns.text: Яко добр блаженнаго Сергия ученик,/ вере и благочестию его подражая,/ стяжал еси даров Духа Святаго сокровище/ и силы многи соделал еси о Господе/ во спасение и утешение верных./ Не остави убо и нас, с верою притекающих к тебе,/ Сильвестре преподобне.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Ин тропарь преподобного Сильвестра Обнорского», глас 4, the second of the two troparia the day page prints under his name, under «Молитвы» for 25 апреля ст. ст.

english.text: As a good disciple of the blessed Sergius, imitating his faith and his piety, thou didst gain the treasure of the gifts of the Holy Spirit and didst work many mighty things in the Lord, for the salvation and the consolation of the faithful. Forsake not us either, then, who run to thee in faith, O venerable Silvester.

hymns.text: Подвигом добрым подвизался еси, преподобне,/ и душу твою, яко жертву чисту и непорочну,/ Духу Святому принеся еси,/ и по смерти твоей стадо твое духовное соблюдавши,/ и в болезнех скоро посещавши./ Темже молим тя, преблаженне:/ с лики преподобных моли Христа Бога,/ да спасет православный христианы/ и подаст людем в мире глубоце устроитися, да зовем ти:/ радуйся, Сильвестре, иноком духовный пастырю и наставниче.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Кондак преподобного Сильвестра Обнорского», глас 6, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 25 апреля ст. ст.

english.text: Thou hast striven the good strife, O venerable one, and hast offered up thy soul to the Holy Spirit as a pure and spotless sacrifice; and after thy death thou dost keep thy spiritual flock and visitest them swiftly in their sicknesses. Therefore we pray thee, most blessed one: with the choirs of the venerable, pray to Christ God that He may save the Orthodox Christians and grant His people to be settled in deep peace, that we may cry to thee: Rejoice, Silvester, spiritual shepherd and teacher of monks.
